(R245) C-Reviews screens — threshold read from qa_settings in the UI; resolved via X-181 QaTicketResolveAction as no native C-Reviews ticket resolve path exists; SAMPLE implemented as an opt-in rendered state.
loss alert = an open QaTicket past sla_due_at, or a review_requests row with rating <= qa_settings.min_public_stars and no resolved ticket, or a resolved request with a low csat_score (< 3)
Resolution screen reopen = status open, resolved_at null, notes kept, SLA restarted 24h from reopen; emits nothing (manifest declares ticket.created and ticket.resolved only)

Suspension-risk events screen reads the current tenant under RLS; a cross-tenant fleet view needs a platform-scoped read that does not exist (same shape as the businesses-policy refusal); listed UNRESOLVED, not faked

Provider cost screen: operator marks a provider cold/warm through ProviderColdAction; writes is_active only, emits nothing (manifest declares no roster event); the autopilot's own cold-marking is unchanged

Connect-a-source screen: tenant connects through IngestConnectAction (secret generated by the action, never shown) and pauses/resumes through IngestSourcePauseAction; writes is_active only, emits nothing; disconnect is pause — rows are never deleted

ReviewRequested carries messageClass (marketing) as a first-class field per R231's send.requested shape; ReviewRequestAction is the only emitter and states the class at both dispatches; closes the 2026-09-04T07:55:55 UNRESOLVED (main's)

Ingest-volume screen: one row per source with run count, records total, last run and rejections; the row action is pause/resume through IngestSourcePauseAction (the module's only write path); emits nothing; a source with no run reads 'never'

Geo-grid screen: grids are created and regenerated through MapsGeogridAction::generateGrid (25 points, rank null); a scan needs the tenant's own Places key (§474) which no module stores yet, so an unscanned grid renders 'Waiting on a Places key' as its finished vendor-gated state and a scan is never faked; holding grids debits nothing (TEST ANCHOR)

Rejected-rows screen: every ingest_rejections row with its reason whole and its signature state; the row action is pause/resume of the rejection's source through IngestSourcePauseAction; no retry exists (raw_payload is null on the HMAC path and a re-ingest needs a fresh attestation); rows are never deleted

tenant: the service-area polygon — the plan's §128.3 SCREENS line; it needs a write path, which MapsPolygonAction does not have yet — define + setActive are the SYSTEM, and G17-22's refusal lives in define: a fence around one building is geo-fenced ad targeting, §44 · P-128

Harvest-coverage screen: one row per active service polygon with the harvested places inside its bounding box, plus 'outside every territory' and 'no coordinates' rows; chains are never listed (G7-21); no harvest is started from the screen — the Places key is the tenant's own and not connected (§474, G8-31), so the screen reads and 'Waiting on a Places key' is its finished vendor-gated state

Service-area screen: polygons are defined and (de)activated through MapsPolygonAction::define/setActive (the module's only polygon write path); define refuses fewer than three points and refuses a fence whose bounding box is under 0.002 degrees on both axes — a fence around one building is geo-fenced ad targeting (G17-22, §44 · P-128) — and a refusal renders as 'Not a service area', never as a failure; setActive fails loudly on an unknown id; rows are never deleted; no map tiles — the polygon is typed as lat,lng lines

Research-dossier screen: one dossier per research run, read from research_runs with its prospect_signals and icebreakers; research is never started from the screen — it fires only on a scored prospect in distress (G3-20, P-146) and its cost lands in ai_calls tagged research, which the screen meters by calendar month; the one write is a grounded icebreaker through IcebreakerGenerateAction::generateIcebreaker, which refuses an empty or non-http(s) source URL (G3-59 · G5-26, P-120) — a refusal renders as 'Not grounded', never as a failure; the 200-at-generation fetch of the TEST ANCHOR waits on an outbound transport the suite cannot fake (Http::fake is forbidden), so the action validates the URL's shape until one exists; rows are never deleted

R245: a seam that ignores its parameters and returns a constant is a stub, and a capability test against it is a refusal, not an assertion; asserting the constant is a change-detector on a string literal (REV-68)

R245: a refusal must name every directory in the module derived from ls, not a remembered list, and must be checked against a grep for the capability id in the module's own source; an id appearing in an implementation docblock proves the seam exists (REV-69)
the id grep is sufficient evidence of a seam and never necessary evidence

R245 (procedure, amending the 11:18 line): before writing a refusal check three places — the module source, the capability's own sentence in capabilities.php, and the test file itself for a sibling test naming the id; the id grep is sufficient evidence of a seam and never necessary evidence, so refuse only when the sentence has no seam (REV-71)

R245: UNRESOLVED may never be written against a module without an ls of that module in the same breath; the classification means 'the dependency is absent' and an absent module is a one-command claim, so ungrounded it parks real capabilities behind a blocker that does not exist (REV-72)

R245: a capability test body must assert the capability named in its docblock; a lint fused into a capability test makes the capability un-classifiable and the lint un-attributable, so the two separate and the lint keeps its own name and its own assertion verbatim (REV-73)
